about: Kinds of system, by their main world. symbol: a letter (unused on a graph map). move: the cost of moving through it (on a graph map, each lane has its own length instead). raw: the producers it has, with how well it suits them (a multiplier on their tfp). coast: unused (a graph map has no sea). raw_max_levels: the most building levels a world-bound producer may have. Smallholdings and wells are the simple way to food and water, on every world; agrifactories and ice refineries the productive one, where a world suits them.
